div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 224px; text-align: center;

text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
CHANGE 1.0.3: getFormResponsesBySite removes answers that the steward hides.
CHANGE 7.0.4: it also returns the question key of each answer.
The site page groups answers by that key. There is no separate query.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
Every protected server action gets the caller from the server session.
Admin checks must use a role that the user cannot change. Browser UI checks are not trusted.
Open question: the role store is not decided (see the proposed ER diagram).

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
US 2.0.8 uses Site, getSiteByName and getFormResponsesBySite.
deleteSite removes the Site's SIRs, answers, attachments, homepage images,
GPX tracks and other Site-owned rows; their S3 files are also removed.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
POST /api/export calls createExportJob.
GET /api/export/status/[jobId] calls getExportJobStatus.
getExportJobStatus returns the URL only to an Admin or the job creator.
The ZIP includes inspection images, homepage images, GPX files and completed PDFs.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
CHANGE 7.0.7: removes the answers of options.hiddenQuestionIds.
CHANGE 7.0.6: processPdfJob reads the SIRs in batches.
The cause of the 50 SIR limit is an open question.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
awardActivityPoints reads the caller from the session.
It checks the source row belongs to the caller and reads site_id from it.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
NEW 4.0.5: the browser calls iNaturalist. handleSubmit copies
each chosen photo to S3 through /api/s3/presign.
insertInspectionAttachments writes inat_observation_id.
CHANGE 4.0.6: photo identifier is optional and does not block submission.
PresignRoute also accepts an empty identifier.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
US 6.0.1 AT 4: results are cached and requests stay under 2,500 per day.
Open question: where the cache and the daily count are stored.
